content: {"reasoning":"The prior CO-16 was already addressed by providing the requested document and submitting the claim with records, and there is no current denial or information request supporting further rework. Another submission could create unnecessary duplicate processing, while appeal, retro authorization, peer-to-peer, patient billing, and write-off are not appropriate. Because no claim-status action is available, a specialist must verify payer receipt and processing status.","action":"escalate"}
